relay.highlights.withheld.line.role: quiet notice line under a Highlights block
relay.highlights.withheld.line.tone: Muted, factual; no blame, no alarm.
relay.highlights.withheld.line.note: Says how many files the agent pinned or named were NOT shown under the answer, then why. {count} is the number of withheld files (plural arms required). {reasons} is one or more of the withheld.reason.* phrases, already translated and joined with the locale's list separator; it is lower-case and never starts the sentence.

relay.highlights.withheld.reason.outside.note: The file is outside the folders Highlights may show (the session folder, home, or this session's scratchpad), or under an operator deny rule.

relay.highlights.withheld.reason.sensiti.note: The file looks like a credential or secret (for example .env or a key file) and is never shown.

relay.highlights.withheld.reason.missing.note: The file the agent named was not found on disk when the turn ended.

relay.highlights.withheld.reason.too_lar.note: The file exceeds the size Highlights will preview.
